title: My page is just my kitten now
text:
My page is just my kitten now- 
You're welcome 🙂‍↕️ https://t.co/lyFEi7kdLM
blurb: The poster has officially turned their page over to their kitten, and honestly, fair. Here a little gray tabby dozes on a cozy red holiday sweater, eyes squeezed shut with the most blissful sleepy smile.
